editorial:
Panther Girl of the Kongo is a 12-chapter Republic Pictures serial directed by Franklin Adreon and written by Ronald Davidson. It was released on January 3, 1955. Jean Evans, a wildlife photographer on a photo safari, is the Panther Girl. The plot involves a mad scientist, Dr. Morgan, giant crayfish called Claw Monsters, and secret diamond mines.

The rights status is unresolved. A catalog search turned up a possible Copyright Office renewal record, RE0000136452, but we could not open the record page. We have not confirmed its claimant, date or scope. Until someone checks the record or a Catalog of Copyright Entries renewal volume by hand, do not assume the print is public domain. The Internet Archive copies, including the colorized upload, do not settle the question either way. Check the Copyright Office record directly before any commercial use.
faq: Is Panther Girl of the Kongo in the public domain?

Unknown. A catalog search indicated a possible renewal record, RE0000136452, but we could not fetch or confirm it. Treat the print as possibly still protected until the record is checked. Being hosted on the Internet Archive does not clear it.
Can I use clips from the Internet Archive colorized version?

Not safely. The colorization is added material, and the underlying serial may have been renewed. The Internet Archive license label was set by the uploader. Check the Copyright Office records or get permission from any rights holder before using clips.
